content.text:
I fixed the about page on phones. I didn't check it in a phone-sized browser, but the 16 functional tests pass.

A leftover rule at the bottom of `site/css/pages.css` was undoing the mobile layout. It set the "How it started" section back to two columns (`1fr 480px`) on small screens. The fixed 480px image column pushed the page wider than the screen. I deleted that rule, so the section now stacks into a single column under 720px, as the mobile styles intended. Wider screens are unaffected.

I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
